package.author: Fabien Penso

en-US.author: Fabien Penso
en-US.longDescription:
Moltis is a secure, persistent personal agent server written in Rust and distributed as a single self-contained binary.
It runs on the user's own hardware and provides sandboxed tool execution, persistent cross-session memory, voice input and output, multi-provider model access, and built-in channels for Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, Slack, Matrix, Nostr and Microsoft Teams. Tools and integrations are exposed through MCP.
en-US.name: Moltis
en-US.releaseNotes:
Fixed
- [providers] Correct DeepSeek thinking tests and refresh Z.AI models (#1317)
- [providers] Use canonical NEAR AI catalog model (#1318)

zh-CN.description: 安全、持久的个人代理服务器。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Moltis 是一款使用 Rust 编写的安全、持久的个人代理服务器，以单个自包含二进制文件分发。
它运行在用户自己的设备上，提供沙箱化工具执行、跨会话的持久记忆、语音输入与输出、多模型接入，并内置 Telegram、WhatsApp、Discord、Slack、Matrix、Nostr 和 Microsoft Teams 等渠道。工具与集成通过 MCP 暴露。
